sentences.text:
The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to impugn the judgment dated 14.12.2023 passed by the court of Sh. Gagandeep Jindal, Additional District Judge,
Rohini Court, Delhi in LAC bearing no.136/2016 titled as Chameli & Ors. V Union of India and Anr.
for further enhancement of the compensation pertaining to the Village Mubarakpur Dabas, Delhi arising out of Award bearing no.16/2005- 06/DC/(NW).
2. Counsel for the appellant stated that a connected Appeal bearing LA APP no.645/2023 titled as Savitri Devi Deceased Through LRs V Union of India & Anr. on similar facts and pertaining to the same Award bearing no.16/2005-06/DC(NW) has already been admitted as regular matter.
